rules.statement: In a partition action, the Court should not deny to parties the right to intervene until the final decree is entered.
rules.supporting_quote: In view of the conclusive effect given to final decrees by section 9 of the Partition Ordinance, Court should not deny to parties the right to intervene in a partition action, until the final decree is entered (vide Menika v. Mudiyanse'[4 C. W. R. 429.]).
